planning t / ascii: Emacs leaves a blank after the last planning timestamp (the same with #+OPTIONS: p:t)
planning t / html: Emacs leaves a blank inside the last planning timestamp's span (the same with #+OPTIONS: p:t)
statistics-cookies nil / latex: the cookie of a list item stays in LaTeX (the same with #+OPTIONS: stat:nil)
tables nil / latex: one blank line more or less where the table was (the same with #+OPTIONS: |:nil)
tasks todo / latex: one blank line more where a done task is left out (the same with #+OPTIONS: tasks:todo)
